desc: A summer beach festival at Daecheon Beach centered on mineral-rich mud play, mud slides, and pools.
Korea's largest cherry blossom festival, held in the Jinhae district with naval port heritage themes.
One of Asia's major film festivals, screening international and Asian cinema centered on the Busan Cinema Center.
A winter festival on a frozen river featuring ice fishing for mountain trout (sancheoneo), sledding, and ice sculptures.
A festival celebrating Korean and international mask dance (talchum) traditions, linked to the Hahoe folk village.
A spring festival among the terraced green tea plantations of Boseong with tea tasting and harvesting experiences.
A lantern festival floating thousands of illuminated lanterns on the Namgang River, rooted in Imjin War history.
An annual lantern festival displaying large illuminated lanterns along the Cheonggyecheon stream in central Seoul.
A large-scale fireworks show over Gwangalli Beach and Gwangan Bridge, one of Korea's biggest pyrotechnic events.
An international jazz festival held on Jarasum island in Gapyeong with Korean and global jazz performers.
A festival celebrating kimchi culture with kimchi-making (kimjang) experiences, tastings, and food programs.
A harvest-themed festival on the Honam plain celebrating rice farming heritage and rural folk culture.
An eco-themed festival in Muju centered on fireflies and their clean-environment habitat in the Deogyusan area.
A festival among Damyang's bamboo groves, including the Juknokwon bamboo forest, with crafts and walking trails.
An early-spring festival among the plum (maehwa) blossom orchards along the Seomjingang River in Gwangyang.
A Jeju folk festival rooted in the old practice of burning fields, held around the first full moon of the lunar year.
A spring cherry blossom festival along Yunjung-ro behind the National Assembly on Yeouido island in Seoul.
A spring flower festival at Korea Flower Park in Taean featuring large tulip displays along the west coast.
A food festival in Jeonju celebrating bibimbap and local Korean cuisine near the Hanok Village area.
A coastal festival in Yeosu commemorating Admiral Yi Sun-sin and the turtle ship naval heritage of the region.
